semiconductor_relevance: High — ASETS is a dedicated provider of semiconductor fabrication equipment, specifically in etch and MOCVD technologies.
summary: Advanced Semiconductor Equipment Technology Singapore (ASETS) specializes in the sales, assembly, and repair of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The company focuses on innovative micro-fabrication solutions that enhance productivity and reduce costs for semiconductor manufacturers globally.

regional_presence.Singapore: ASETS operates as a Singapore-registered company with a focus on serving local and international semiconductor manufacturers.
